name: 仅图形可见的指标口径核对

production_refs.intent_summary: 核对新老用户流失率定义及异常日期的原始数据。
production_refs.review_basis: 沿用清洗后已接受的AStudio桌面去身份用途原型；本阶段由作者模型合成素材并由两个模型独立标图，不证明生产结果正确或人类原创。
production_refs.adaptation: 保留业务目标/工作形态，重构合成数据、规模、冲突和边界；不是原请求或用户附件的逐字复制。

source_proofs.scope: Source/pixel metadata and arithmetic checks only. Literal drawing text equivalence is not an OCR-engine run; independent visual annotations and final interval GT remain pending.

authorization.reply: 授权两名子代理独立模型标注（推荐）
authorization.scope: H022 only: two independent image-first model annotators, 20 readings and 8 claims each, including necessary revision rechecks; never human experts.

model_annotation.model_error_correlation_limit: Two independent model contexts may share errors; this is not human expert or native statistical review.

v2_clarity_revision.before: 仅凭此图即可确认W5单周新增精确等于60000人，误差不超过1人。
v2_clarity_revision.after: W5单周新增用户的实际人数在59999至60001人之间（含边界）。
v2_clarity_revision.reason: Both raw reviews distinguish the unknown numerical fact from the unsupported assertion that the image can confirm it. Remove that meta-assertion so the public composite-claim rule has one unambiguous factual object.

provenance.limit: Independent models reviewed original images and claims, not this workbook. Author reference was checked against those sources and real native Office. No business grader, candidate control matrix, formal MD Worker, independent candidate semantic score or Harness result yet.

limits: Authorized double model annotation, not human experts or a guarantee against correlated errors.
Literal drawing text identity is not an OCR-engine benchmark.
Model reading envelopes are provenance, not unique mandatory candidate intervals.
Reference formula perturbations do not require every candidate to use formulas.
Author reference and source QA do not prove task scoring, Harness behavior, calibrated L3 or model/Harness discrimination.
